topics.title: Plant Structure & Anatomy
topics.description: Start with cannabis as a plant: organs, tissues, growth points, leaves, stems, flowers, and the structures that support growth.

topics.title: Seeds, Germination & Seedlings
topics.description: Seed structure, dormancy, germination, emergence, early roots, cotyledons, seedling establishment, and propagation fundamentals.

topics.title: Roots, Rhizosphere & Growing Media
topics.description: Root development, oxygen and water uptake, rhizosphere biology, soil and substrate properties, containers, and media testing.

topics.title: Plant Physiology
topics.description: Photosynthesis, respiration, transport, source-sink relationships, hormones, stress responses, and whole-plant coordination.

topics.title: Water & Environment
topics.description: Plant water relations, transpiration, humidity, VPD, temperature, airflow, environmental stress, and climate control.

topics.title: Lighting & Photobiology
topics.description: PPFD, DLI, spectrum, photoperiod, light response, measurement, fixture placement, and plant-light interactions.

topics.title: Nutrition & Root-Zone Chemistry
topics.description: Essential elements, nutrient uptake, pH, EC, alkalinity, nutrient interactions, deficiencies, toxicities, and root-zone chemistry.

topics.title: Genetics, Sex & Chemotype
topics.description: Inheritance, variation, genotype and phenotype, sex expression, chemotype, genomic concepts, and trait interpretation.

topics.title: Cloning, Tissue Culture & Germplasm
topics.description: Cuttings, rooting, mother plants, tissue culture, sanitation, preservation, and germplasm management.

topics.title: Training & Canopy Architecture
topics.description: Branching, apical dominance, pruning, LST, HST, SCROG, canopy development, and training biology.

topics.title: Flowering & Reproduction
topics.description: Floral transition, reproductive development, pollen, fertilization, seed formation, and flowering biology.

topics.title: Trichomes & Cannabinoids
topics.description: Glandular trichomes, cannabinoid biosynthesis, maturation, resin development, and evidence-based interpretation.

topics.title: Terpenes & Secondary Metabolites
topics.description: Terpenes, volatiles, flavonoids, secondary metabolism, aroma chemistry, and environmental influences.

topics.title: Diagnostics & Abiotic Disorders
topics.description: Symptom reasoning, nutrient and environmental disorders, root stress, light injury, water stress, and differential diagnosis.

topics.title: Pests
topics.description: Arthropod and invertebrate pests, identification, life cycles, damage patterns, monitoring, and intervention context.

topics.title: Diseases & Viroids
topics.description: Fungal, bacterial, viral and viroid problems, disease development, symptom patterns, testing, and risk factors.

topics.title: IPM, Biosecurity & Sanitation
topics.description: Integrated pest management, prevention, scouting, sanitation, exclusion, thresholds, records, and biosecurity.

topics.title: Harvest & Postharvest
topics.description: Harvest timing, handling, drying, curing, moisture and water activity, storage, quality, and postharvest science.

topics.title: Outdoor & Greenhouse Growing
topics.description: Site selection, weather, microclimate, soil, irrigation, wind, rain, greenhouse ecology, and outdoor crop risks.

topics.title: Breeding & Genetic Conservation
topics.description: Selection, crossing, generations, population structure, inbreeding, preservation, evaluation, and genetic conservation.

topics.title: Measurement & Research Skills
topics.description: Measurement quality, sensors, sampling, experimental design, records, uncertainty, statistics, and research literacy.
